user.title: Connect Chaster
user.description:
Enter your Chaster developer token.

How to get one:
1. Open the Chaster developer area at {developers_url} and request API access if you have not already been approved.
2. After approval, open the Chaster Developer interface.
3. Create or open an application.
4. Select Tokens in the left sidebar.
5. Click Generate a developer token and copy the token.

No OAuth login, client ID, client secret, or browser redirect is required. Keep the token secret.
